column3: “to one another” renders “each to its sister.”
“porpoise skins” renders “tahash skins,” an animal whose identity is uncertain.
“tenons” renders “hands,” and “to one another” renders “each to its sister.”
“the rear” renders “the innermost (farthest) parts” (also in verses 23 and 27).
“double” renders “twins”; the construction of the corner frames is uncertain.
